role: ours_method_candidate; not ContextCite; not LUMINA; baselines remain unchanged
method_boundary: Our exact three-source attribution candidate. It does not modify, retrain, tune, or relabel any ContextCite, LUMINA, Lookback Lens, ReDeEP, HalluRAG, or other baseline.

cohort.source_input: Frozen label-free LUMINA preparation artifact; original view only.

intervention.sources: The exact original Passage 1/2/3 character segments, including headers and inter-passage whitespace.
intervention.views: All masks 000..111 in integer order; selected segments retain original source order. Empty removes only the exact material block.
intervention.fixed_content: Prompt text outside that block and the published answer bytes are identical in all eight views.
intervention.tokenization: One full-string fast-tokenizer call per view, literal existing Llama wrapper, no added tokens, padding, truncation, or generation.
intervention.frozen_coordinates: Prompt/shell/passage hashes, prefix token IDs, full-input hashes, answer/predictor positions, response offsets, and kept-source token positions.

extraction.quantization: NF4 double quantization; BF16 compute/storage conventions copied from the audited QA replay.
extraction.score: For every published answer token and every subset, log softmax probability of the selected next token at its teacher-forced predictor position.
extraction.execution: Eight views run sequentially. gpu-smoke and extract are separate explicit commands guarded by a cross-run lock, foreign-compute-process check, and free-memory gate.

features.axis: One unchanged raw answer BPE axis shared by all views.
features.full_empty: f(111)-f(000), plus full and empty NLL.
features.shapley: Exact n=3 Shapley values over all eight log-probability coalitions; efficiency sum(phi)=f(111)-f(000) checked per token.
features.source_effects: Three empty-to-single gains and three full leave-one-source-out drops.
features.dispersion: Eight-view range and population standard deviation.
features.interactions: Three pair and one triple exact Mobius/Harsanyi interactions, plus fixed summaries.
features.citations: A token inherits valid Passage IDs cited in its fixed automatic sentence claim; cited Shapley/gain/drop summaries use that frozen bit mask. Missing citations remain explicit zero-indicator cases.

readout.labels: Opened only by score after every GPU cache is frozen. Train only on lexical raw BPE labels.
readout.model: Fixed StandardScaler plus L2 LogisticRegression, C=0.1, liblinear, seed fixed; no architecture or hyperparameter search.
readout.crossfit: Five GroupKFold splits by source-connected group produce every fit token prediction; one all-fit model predicts calibration.
readout.weights: Within each training fold: equal source-group mass, then equal answer/token mass; binary class balance, then restore equal source-group loss mass.
readout.thresholds: Window and answer thresholds selected only on fit OOF predictions. Calibration is reporting only.
readout.projection: Unchanged eligible stride-one 4-original-BPE windows receive max lexical-token risk; answer receives max eligible-window risk.

stage_gate: initialize -> prepare -> check -> audit; after review only gpu-smoke -> extract -> score
limitations: Teacher-forced source removal measures conditional evidence influence, not a historical causal trace. Removing passages also changes length and positions. Correlated passages make individual attribution share-dependent.
